day_shape: 81 items: two same-day CENTCOM strike waves on Iranian Strait of Hormuz targets plus naval blockade, IRGC claims retaliatory missile/drone attacks on US bases in Kuwait and Jordan, State Dept sanctions four individuals and three entities over IRGC weapons procurement, Trump announces release of US citizen held since December 2024, UK terror-law reviewer cites Iran plot wave behind IRGC framework.

threads.label: US strikes and Strait of Hormuz blockade
threads.summary: CENTCOM announced two waves of strikes on Iranian military targets on 15 July, at 6 a.m. and 3 p.m. ET, and said its restarted naval blockade had redirected two commercial vessels in 17 hours. Jerusalem Post reported Trump was weighing expanded airstrikes, a Kharg Island ground operation and hitting a nuclear facility, with sources telling Reuters wider operations were possible.

threads.label: IRGC claims strikes on US bases in Kuwait and Jordan
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press carried IRGC Statements 15, 16 and 17 claiming Khaybar Shekan missile and drone strikes destroyed a C-RAM radar and satellite communications and early warning systems at Ali al-Salem air base and a troop pier at Shaibaiyah in Kuwait, plus a US command centre and fighter maintenance ramp at Zarqa in Jordan. Iran's army spokesman Brigadier General Akrami-Nia said the Strait of Hormuz would remain closed unless Washington accepted Iran's terms, and Jerusalem Post noted former FM Mottaki called for seizing a US base.

threads.label: US-Iran sanctions, detainees and diplomatic touchpoints
threads.summary: The State Department imposed sanctions on four individuals and three entities facilitating IRGC weapons procurement, citing continued Iranian threats to freedom of navigation despite an MOU. Trump announced the release of a US citizen detained by Iran since December 2024, while British national Craig Foreman's family said Iran added two years to his 10-year sentence, and IRIB reported a Katz-Hegseth call on US military activity in Iran.

threads.label: Khamenei martyrdom messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted three items around the 18 Tir funeral of Iran's "martyred Imam", thanking tens of millions in Iran and Iraq and reiterating that every martyr constitutes a "file of vengeance". IRIB and Defa Press ran commemorations for IRGC Brigadier General Gheib-Parvar and coverage of hospital evacuations and civilian impact from US strikes.

threads.label: Israel operations in Gaza and southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said strikes killed Hamas sniper commander Omar Ahmed Abu Qasem, Nukhba commanders Ali Shamlakh and Nasser Louh, October 7 abduction participant Hussam al-Shafie, and three armed Hezbollah operatives near Beit Yahoun. Israeli officials told the Security Cabinet the IDF controls 67-70% of Gaza, and Jerusalem Post reported Israel and Lebanon agreed on two pilot zones to disarm Hezbollah across 52 southern villages.

threads.label: Iranian activity in Europe and UK IRGC framework
threads.summary: Iran International reported UK independent terror-law reviewer Jonathan Hall said Britain's new IRGC legal framework was driven by the scale of alleged Iranian activity on British soil rather than political pressure. Jerusalem Post cited the EU linking Iranian actors and criminal networks to terror attacks recorded across 21 member states last year, and Times of Israel reported an IDF soldier sentenced to five years for spying for Iran.

threads.label: Internal Iranian politics and southern front
threads.summary: Iran International reported hardliners lost key posts on parliament's National Security and Foreign Policy Committee amid divisions over Ghalibaf-led talks with Washington, and a senior cleric urged officials not to keep negotiating over infrastructure threats. A separate report described Iran's southern coast as visibly at war while Tehran debates, and the health committee opened a probe into a $55 million medical-import allocation.
